model_laws.statement: Electrical activity alone is never heat.
A human report never counts as a sensor measurement.
An old or superseded reading is never current.
Images and personal details never enter HVAC payloads.
Weather forecast context never decides readiness on its own.

process_laws.stage: Fix the whole problem class and add a safeguard
process_laws.statement: Every repaired row in docs/audit-3.md and docs/audit-4.md names at least one regression test file that exists.

process_laws.stage: Prove the safeguard catches the failure
process_laws.statement: Every repaired row in docs/audit-4.md has a matching entry in docs/red-proofs.md.
Every task listed in docs/build-log/README.md has its prompt file, and every prompt file is listed.
.env.example contains placeholders only and no live flag is set to 1.
CI never enables live inference, delivery, Emporia or visual live flags.

process_laws.stage: Restart and confirm the new version is running
process_laws.statement: /api/health reports the running version once day11-09 lands.

process_laws.stage: Merge into the release batch / Deploy
process_laws.statement: A release batch is pushed only with Brad's approval; a deployment needs his approval of a specific host and step.
